get.description: Ratification throughput: the median time from proposal to decision, and how much of the backlog is older than an age you name. The age is required because no bar has been chosen for this metric, and a default here would be one invented by accident.

post.description: Records one run of verdicts on whether code still honors the atoms that govern it. No field accepts source code. Verdicts are recorded and never acted on: nothing here edits code, opens a pull request, or changes an atom.
